title: Compression, sealing and mechanical health
whatItIs: Compression and sealing determine whether the trapped mixture can turn into useful pressure. OBD cannot directly measure compression, but graph contradictions can tell the app when a mechanical test is required.
normalValues: A mechanically healthy engine has stable idle, plausible MAP/vacuum, smooth RPM, expected airflow for displacement and no persistent cylinder-specific misfire.
deviations: Low idle vacuum/MAP instability with no clear mixture fault can indicate sealing
Low VE at WOT with weak intake/exhaust indices suggests cam/compression issue
One-cylinder misfire after ignition/fuel swap points to compression or valve leakage
Tight valves can be worse hot
influence: Mechanical faults cannot be fixed by sensors. The app should recommend compression/leak-down instead of guessing parts when the graph demands it.
checks: Cylinder balance and bore inspection when needed
